ios.desc:
Welcome to TileSplash – The Ultimate Tile Merging Puzzle Game!

Dive into the addictive world of TileSplash, where strategy meets fun! Challenge your mind, sharpen your skills, and experience the thrill of merging tiles in this beautifully designed puzzle game. Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, TileSplash offers endless entertainment and brain-teasing challenges.

Features That Make TileSplash Irresistible:

Innovative Gameplay
Merge tiles with matching numbers to create higher values and score big! Plan your moves carefully to trigger massive cascades and unlock powerful multipliers.

Easy to Learn, Hard to Master
Simple tap controls make it easy for anyone to play, but mastering the game requires strategy and foresight. Can you achieve the highest score?

Stunning Visuals
Enjoy a clean and vibrant design with smooth animations that make every move satisfying. The game adapts perfectly to all screen sizes, including iPhones and iPads.

Immersive Sound Effects
Feel the excitement with dynamic sound effects that enhance your gameplay experience. Prefer a quiet game? Easily toggle sound on or off in the settings.

Compete and Achieve
Track your best scores and multipliers as you aim to beat your personal records. Share your achievements with friends and challenge them to beat your score!

Optimized for All Devices
Whether you're playing on an iPhone or iPad, TileSplash delivers a seamless experience with responsive design and smooth performance.

Why You'll Love TileSplash:

Strategic Fun: Every move counts! Plan ahead to create the ultimate cascade and maximize your score.

Relaxing Yet Challenging: Play at your own pace or push your limits to achieve higher scores.

Perfect for All Ages: Whether you're 8 or 80, TileSplash is a game everyone can enjoy.

Quick Sessions or Long Play: Play a quick round during your break or immerse yourself in hours of gameplay.

How to Play:

Tap tiles to merge numbers and create higher values.

Strategize your moves to trigger cascades and multipliers.

Aim for the highest score and beat your best multiplier!

Play Anywhere, Anytime
TileSplash is perfect for playing on the go, during your commute, or while relaxing at home. With offline support, you can enjoy the game anytime, anywhere.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Tilesplash – Merge and Cascade Puzzle Game with Two Modes

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m a solo indie developer, and I just launched Tilesplash — a mobile puzzle game I’ve been working on for the past few months.

Instead of just matching tiles, you merge numbers to trigger satisfying cascades. Planning ahead creates chain reactions and higher scores.

Two main modes:
- Classic: endless score chase for quick sessions
- Adventure: level-based puzzles with limited moves/objectives

What makes it different:
- Unique cascade + merge mechanics (not just match-3 or 2048)
- Minimal, colorful design with smooth animations
- Optional power-up via rewarded ad — no paywalls, no forced ads
- Privacy-compliant with App Tracking Transparency on iOS

Links:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/tilesplash/id6747778208?l=fr-CA

Would love feedback from the HN community — especially on first impressions, onboarding, and ideas for improving retention.
